title: The crystal structure of Vibrio cholerae (6-4) photolyase reveals interactions with cofactors and a DNA binding region
authors: Baris Cakilkaya; Ibrahim Halil Kavakli; Hasan DeMirci
one_liner_zh: 该文解析霍乱弧菌(6-4)光裂合酶晶体结构，涉及辅因子互作与DNA结合区域推测，属蛋白质-DNA互作的结构生物学研究，但无AI或物理模拟方法，仅间接相关。
abstract: Photolyases (PLs) reverse UV-induced DNA damage using blue light as an energy source. Of these photolyases, (6-4) PLs repair (6-4)-lesioned photoproducts. We recently identified a gene from Vibrio cholerae (Vc ) encoding a (6-4) PL, but structural characterization is needed to elucidate specific interactions with the chromophore cofactors. Here, we determined the crystal structure of Vc (6-4) PL at 2.5 Å resolution. Our high-resolution structure revealed that the two well-known cofactors, flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) and the photoantenna 6,7-dimethyl 8-ribityl-lumazin (DMRL), stably interact with an α-helical and an α/β domain, respectively. Additionally, the structure has a third cofactor with distinct electron clouds corresponding to a [4Fe-4S] cluster. Moreover, we identified that Asp106 makes a hydrogen bond with the water and DMRL, which indicates further stabilization of the photoantenna DMRL within Vc (6-4) PL. Further analysis of the Vc (6-4) PL structure revealed a possible region responsible for DNA binding. The region located between residues 478-484 may bind the lesioned DNA, with Arg483 potentially forming a salt bridge with DNA to stabilize further the interaction of Vc (6-4) PL with its substrate. Our comparative analysis revealed that the DNA lesion could not bind to the Vc (6-4) PL in a similar fashion to the Drosophila melanogaster Dm (6-4) PL without a significant conformational change of the protein. The 23 rd helix of the bacterial (6-4) PLs seems to have remarkable plasticity, and conformational changes facilitate DNA binding. In conclusion, our structure provides further insight into DNA repair by a (6-4) PL containing three cofactors.
abstract_zh: 光裂合酶（photolyases, PLs）利用蓝光作为能量来源逆转紫外线诱导的DNA损伤。在这些光裂合酶中，(6-4) PLs修复(6-4)损伤的光产物。我们最近从霍乱弧菌（Vibrio cholerae, Vc）中鉴定出一个编码(6-4) PL的基因，但需要结构表征来阐明与发色团辅因子的特异性相互作用。在此，我们确定了Vc (6-4) PL在2.5 Å分辨率下的晶体结构。我们的高分辨率结构揭示，两个众所周知的辅因子，黄素腺嘌呤二核苷酸（flavin adenine dinucleotide, FAD）和光天线6,7-二甲基-8-核糖基-鲁马嗪（6,7-dimethyl 8-ribityl-lumazin, DMRL），分别与一个α螺旋结构域和一个α/β结构域稳定相互作用。此外，该结构具有第三个辅因子，其独特的电子云对应于一个[4Fe-4S]簇。而且，我们鉴定出Asp106与水及DMRL形成氢键，这表明进一步稳定了Vc (6-4) PL内的光天线DMRL。对Vc (6-4) PL结构的进一步分析揭示了一个可能负责DNA结合的区域。位于残基478-484之间的区域可能结合损伤的DNA，其中Arg483可能通过形成盐桥与DNA相互作用，以进一步稳定Vc (6-4) PL与其底物的结合。我们的比较分析揭示，DNA损伤无法以类似于黑腹果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）Dm (6-4) PL的方式结合到Vc (6-4) PL上，除非蛋白质发生显著构象变化。细菌(6-4) PLs的第23个螺旋似乎具有显著的塑性，构象变化促进了DNA结合。总之，我们的结构为含有三个辅因子的(6-4) PL进行DNA修复提供了进一步见解。
